This small plot is very small, and here in Kigoma I usually manage with what my household can afford and what we have at home. I will intercrop it and use local seed because improved seed and chemical fertilizer cost money, and for this kind of plot I do not usually buy many inputs. I can put some manure or compost if I have it, and we will use family hands for the work instead of hiring labor.
